info.title: Laundry Pickup API
info.description: API for customer orders, laundry services, delivery operations, administration, payments, and notifications. Protected endpoints require a JWT in the Authorization header.

post.description: Customer token required. Service prices and delivery fee are calculated by the server. pickupTime is accepted as a legacy alternative to pickupTimeSlot.

patch.description: Only pending and pickup_assigned orders can be cancelled. No request body is used.

get.summary: Get one of the customer's orders

patch.summary: Assign a delivery agent to a paid pending order

deliveryAgentId.description: MongoDB ID of an active delivery_agent

get.summary: List orders assigned to the delivery agent

patch.summary: Mark processing laundry as ready for delivery
Mark an order out for delivery

post.description: Admin token required. Send multipart form data; image must be JPEG, PNG, or WebP and no larger than 5 MB.

get.summary: Get an active service by ID (admin)

patch.description: Admin token required. Send multipart form data. All fields are optional; provide image only to replace the current image.

post.summary: Initialize Paystack payment for an order
post.description: Customer token required. Amount is read from the order in the database. No request body is used.

200.description: Payment verified or was already verified

post.description: Called by Paystack, not by a logged-in user. The server validates x-paystack-signature using PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY. Send the raw Paystack JSON event.

parameters.name: x-paystack-signature
parameters.description: HMAC SHA-512 signature generated by Paystack.

200.description: Webhook acknowledged (also for ignored events or unknown references)

get.summary: List notifications for the authenticated user

notifications.title: Order Created
notifications.message: Your laundry order has been created successfully.

BearerAuth.description: Use the token returned by POST /api/auth/login or /api/auth/register. Swagger UI adds the Authorization: Bearer header after Authorize.

RegisterRequest.description: Public registration creates a customer role; role is not accepted from the request.

oneOf.description: Address line shorthand accepted by the API.

pickupTime.description: Legacy alternative to pickupTimeSlot; same allowed values.

image.description: JPEG, PNG, or WebP image; maximum size 5 MB.

isActive.description: Multipart forms may send the literal strings true or false.

image.description: Optional replacement image; JPEG, PNG, or WebP, maximum 5 MB.
